newsitem.title: USA: Barbers Hairstyling to buy We Care Hair.
newsitem.headline: Barbers Hairstyling to buy We Care Hair.

text.p: Barbers Hairstyling for Men & Women Inc said Thursday it signed a preliminary agreement to acquire We Care Hair Development Inc for about $2 million plus a percentage of future royalties.
We Care Hair operates 145 value-priced hair care salons in the United States and Mexico, primarily in Illinois, Indiana and Ohio, Barbers Hairstyling said.

Barbers Hairstyling provides hair styling and hair care products through a chain of 798 franchised and company-owned salons operating under the Cost Cutters Family Hair Care and City Looks Salons International names.
